system.description:
Deal [(SR+3)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. 

(Target: Decay): Increase the damage of this skill equal to the rating of [Decay] on the target.

A special skill that enchants the spirit of an inugami, who is an incarnation of a curse, in the armor and devours the enemy. The power of its fangs increases in sharpness according to the strength of the poison or curse that undermines the enemy.
